---
title: "2. PCA"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-16"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# Update paths and sample names in the USER SETTINGS section as needed.
# =============================================================================
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# 1. USER SETTINGS

input_file <- "data/salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv"
gene_column <- "gene_id"

samples_to_use <- c(
  "HD10-diff_1","HD10-diff_2","HD10-diff_3",
  "HD10-und_1","HD10-und_2","HD10-und_3",
  "HD10-mockVZV_1","HD10-mockVZV_2","HD10-mockVZV_3",
  "HD10-VZV_1","HD10-VZV_2","HD10-VZV_3"
)

top_variable_genes <- 500

# Save in same folder as input
output_plot <- "results/PCA_plot.pdf"

# 2. LOAD DATA

expr <- read_tsv(input_file)

expr_matrix <- expr %>%
  column_to_rownames(gene_column) %>%
  select(all_of(samples_to_use))

# Optional log transform (recommended for counts)
expr_matrix <- log2(expr_matrix + 1)

# 3. FILTER MOST VARIABLE GENES

gene_variance <- apply(expr_matrix, 1, var)

top_genes <- names(sort(gene_variance, decreasing = TRUE))[1:top_variable_genes]

expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[top_genes, ]

# 4. RUN PCA

pca <- prcomp(t(expr_matrix), scale. = TRUE)

pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
pca_df$sample <- rownames(pca_df)

# 4b. CUSTOM SAMPLE LABELS

custom_labels <- c(
  "HD10-diff_1" = "Diff 1",
  "HD10-diff_2" = "Diff 2",
  "HD10-diff_3" = "Diff 3",
  "HD10-und_1" = "Undiff 1",
  "HD10-und_2" = "Undiff 2",
  "HD10-und_3" = "Undiff 3",
  "HD10-mockVZV_1" = "Mock 1",
  "HD10-mockVZV_2" = "Mock 2",
  "HD10-mockVZV_3" = "Mock 3",
  "HD10-VZV_1" = "VZV 1",
  "HD10-VZV_2" = "VZV 2",
  "HD10-VZV_3" = "VZV 3"
)

# Add custom labels to PCA dataframe
pca_df$label <- custom_labels[pca_df$sample]

# 5. ASSIGN GROUPS FROM SAMPLE NAMES

pca_df <- pca_df %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    str_detect(sample, "diff") ~ "Differentiated",
    str_detect(sample, "und") ~ "Undifferentiated",
    str_detect(sample, "mockVZV") ~ "Mock",
    str_detect(sample, "VZV") ~ "VZV infected",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

# 6. VARIANCE EXPLAINED

var_explained <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

pc1_var <- round(var_explained[1] * 100, 1)
pc2_var <- round(var_explained[2] * 100, 1)

# 7. PLOT PCA

p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Differentiated" = "red3",
    "Undifferentiated" = "blue3",
    "Mock" = "gray23",
    "VZV infected" = "forestgreen"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "%)"),
    color = "Group"
  )

# 8. SAVE PLOT

# Save PDF
ggsave("results/PCA_plot.pdf", p, width = 5, height = 3)

# Save high-resolution PNG
ggsave(
  "results/PCA_plot.png",
  p,
  width = 5,
  height = 3,
  dpi = 600
)

print(p)

```
